changes.text: Fixed many Hold powers that were incorrectly causing targets to use the ‘disoriented’ animation, including Cinder, Block of Ice, Strangler, Fossilize, and Freezing Touch.
Shield Defense – Fixed a bug that caused some falling animations to loop with a shield out.
Ninja Run (available through the Martial Arts Pack) - Corrected PvP suppression speed and height values for the Ninja Run power. They were set equivalent to Super Jump, instead of the proper values.
